columns.program_segments.kind: TEXT: ton (picture and sound) | off (sound only)
columns.program_segments.sort_index: INTEGER, position in the program, 0-based, no gaps
columns.program_segments.in_frame: INTEGER, source IN frame of the clip
columns.program_segments.out_frame: INTEGER, source OUT frame (exclusive), at least IN + 1
columns.program_segments.fps_num: INTEGER, source timebase numerator confirmed by the player; one timebase per story
columns.program_markers.program_frame: INTEGER, user M marker on the program axis, strictly inside the program (0 < frame < program length), one per frame; the program start and the end of the last segment are markers by position and are not stored; deleting a segment drops markers inside it and moves later ones left (v5)
